slides.title: Holidays are 8 weeks away. Start this tiny reset now, not December.
One drawer a week
slides.body: Pick the drawer that jams. Empty it, toss the obvious trash, put it back. Eight weeks, eight drawers that close.

slides.title: Clear one landing zone
slides.body: Guests, gifts and bags all land on the same surface. Clear it now so December has somewhere to put stuff.

slides.title: Find the hosting stuff early
slides.body: Extra towels, the big platter, the folding chairs. Find them this month while you're calm, not the night before.

slides.title: Make a 'December box'
slides.body: Tape, gift bags, batteries, stamps. One box, one spot. No more buying tape for the fourth time.

slides.title: December me is not a different person. She's me, but tired. So I'm helping her now.
Want the full 7-day plan?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, a 7-day shame-free ADHD home reset. Link in bio.
